topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Today, I was walking through the hall, just another day, and all of a sudden, there it was, a small, wrapped box on my desk. No note, just this carefully packaged surprise. I looked around, hoping to spot the giver, but no one seemed to notice or care. I fingered the edges of the paper, wondering if I should open it now or wait. What if it was something deeply personal, a token from years back, or maybe just the student's way of saying thanks, finally finding the words or the courage. I took a deep breath and unwrapped it slowly, hoping my hands wouldn’t betray the flutter of anticipation.
